claims.claim: Equivalent semantic declarations and source bytes produce the same capsule digest regardless of input array order, source root, or relative input paths.
claims.passCondition: Independent directory layouts and reordered declarations produce an identical capsule digest.
claims.primarySurface: focused execution with two real source directory layouts
claims.counterevidence: path or ordering alone changes the digest
claims.namedSeam: logical locator and declared semantics remain intentional digest inputs

claims.claim: The capsule binds exact source files without embedding their contents or machine paths.
claims.passCondition: capsule contains source schema, digest, size, class, freshness, role, and logical locator but no inputPath, source root, or fixture payload
claims.counterevidence: any linked content or machine input path appears in output
claims.observedEvidence: selftest output inspection across a 16 KiB linked payload
claims.namedSeam: a digest does not prove a declared source classification truthful, and declaration text still needs privacy review

claims.claim: A linked source change invalidates reverification and holds action.
claims.passCondition: modify a real linked file, restart observation, and receive FAIL plus HELD and SOURCE_DIGEST_MISMATCH
claims.observedEvidence: selftest real file mutation and reverification assertions
claims.namedSeam: source match covers the stored file, not remote state represented by that file

claims.claim: Matching stored digests never erase REPROBE_REQUIRED for volatile external state.
claims.passCondition: unchanged capsule and source verification passes while actionState remains REPROBE_REQUIRED and the resume card names it
claims.counterevidence: stored digest match yields READY for a volatile source
claims.namedSeam: a separate live receiver probe is still required

claims.claim: Declared private/user sources, repetitive telemetry, temporary captures, and unclassified material cannot produce READY.
claims.observedEvidence: selftest covers all four refused source classes

claims.claim: The compact resume card is digest-bound to one verified READY capsule and preserves goal, first action, decisions, loops, sources, freshness, and boundaries.
claims.passCondition: card verification passes and text carries every required semantic section plus capsule digest
claims.counterevidence: card changes without digest failure or omits freshness/authority sections
claims.observedEvidence: selftest card integrity and required-section assertions
claims.namedSeam: the card remains a derived view, not memory authority

claims.claim: Compilation and cards grant no action, permission, memory.handoff, promotion, roots, or CANON authority.
claims.passCondition: contract refuses these effects, runtime truth keeps them false, and no network/subprocess/repository-write capability exists
claims.counterevidence: any authority flag becomes true or prohibited capability appears
claims.observedEvidence: selftest contract, dependency, and truth assertions
claims.namedSeam: human and declared steward review seats remain external

claims.claim: For the declared real build-state source set, the compact resume text is materially smaller than reading every linked source first.
claims.passCondition: measure UTF-8 resume text bytes and exact linked source bytes for the same compiled capsule; resume text is smaller and both values are preserved
claims.primarySurface: runtime byte measurement under the named nine-source build-state declaration
claims.counterevidence: resume text is equal to or larger than the linked source total
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: artifact size and capsule metrics inspection
claims.observedEvidence: 5,366 resume-text bytes versus 28,150 linked-source bytes, an 80.9% reduction for this declared set
claims.namedSeam: byte reduction is not a general token, intelligence, or reasoning-quality claim
